what: main guard driven by Artifacts event subscriptions (Queues) plus a head check at every merge round
where: git-flare-staging Worker + Artifacts namespace gf-staging + queue gf-events-staging; repository gd-4436 watched with scripts/watch-repo.mjs (events: pushed, token.created, cloned, fetched)
subscriptionFacts: Repository-level events (pushed, cloned, fetched, token.*) need a subscription per repository: source artifacts.repo with namespace and repo_name; the API rejects a subscription without them.
repo_name '*' is accepted by the API but delivered nothing for pushes to other repositories within 60 s: it matches a repository literally named '*'.
Event types in the API are the short names (pushed, token.created); the cf.artifacts.repo.* names are rejected at creation and appear only in delivered messages.

tamper.how: a write token issued with `wrangler artifacts repos issue-token` (outside the platform), then a commit pushed to main with it
tamper.firstSignal: foreign-write-token (the token.created event arrived before the push event)

afterwards.queueLastError: MAIN_GUARD: write token ... minted on gd-4436 outside the platform
